messages.content: Write a concise incident note: Backup stopped: destination disk full. No backup created.
Backup failed because the destination disk is full. No new backup exists. Check capacity and retention, rerun the job, and verify the backup.
Write a concise incident note: Website returned 502 after a deploy. Backend process was stopped.
The website returned 502 after deployment because its backend was stopped. Inspect the service logs, restore the backend, and verify the site responds.
Write a concise incident note: DNS lookups timed out. Resolver service was not running.
DNS resolution failed while the resolver was stopped. Review its logs, restore the service, and test a lookup.
Write a concise incident note: Nightly copy did not finish. Network connection dropped midway.
The nightly copy was interrupted by a network disconnect. Check connectivity, rerun the copy, and verify destination files.
Write a concise incident note: Container restarted repeatedly. Required config file was missing.
The container restart loop followed a missing configuration file. Restore the intended configuration, restart the container, and check its health.
Write a concise incident note: Monitoring stopped updating. Exporter process exited.
Metrics stopped updating after the exporter exited. Review exporter logs, restore it, and confirm fresh samples arrive.
Write a concise incident note: Storage alert fired at 90 percent. No service outage observed.
Storage usage reached 90 percent without an observed outage. Review growth and retention, plan capacity, and monitor available space.
Write a concise incident note: Certificate expired. Browser blocked HTTPS connection.
HTTPS access failed because the certificate expired. Renew and deploy the certificate, then verify the certificate chain and expiry.
Write a concise incident note: Scheduled job never started. Schedule was disabled.
The scheduled job did not start because its schedule was disabled. Confirm the intended schedule, enable it, and verify the next execution.
Write a concise incident note: Application could not write logs. Log directory permissions changed.
The application lost log-write access after directory permissions changed. Restore the intended permissions and verify new log entries.
Write a concise incident note: Database refused connections. Connection limit was reached.
Database connections were refused at the connection limit. Inspect active sessions and application pooling, then verify recovery.
Write a concise incident note: Health check failed after port changed from 8000 to 9000.
The health check used the old port after a port change. Update the check to the intended port and confirm healthy responses.
Write a concise incident note: Sync completed but file checksum differed.
The synchronized file failed checksum verification. Compare source and destination, repeat transfer from the trusted source, and verify the checksum again.
Write a concise incident note: Machine rebooted unexpectedly. Cause not yet known.
The machine rebooted unexpectedly; the cause is unconfirmed. Review system and power-event logs before assigning a cause.
Write a concise incident note: API returned 401. Client token had expired.
API authentication failed because the client token expired. Renew credentials through the approved process and verify access without logging secrets.
Write a concise incident note: Queue backlog increased while worker was stopped.
The queue backlog grew while its worker was stopped. Review the worker failure, restore processing, and monitor backlog reduction.
